original_title: O nascimento da imprensa brasileira
note: Candidate uses the variant O nascimento da imprensa no Brasil, also used in the Academia Brasileira de Letras bibliography; same 2003 Zahar book.

original_title: Qu’est-ce que la littérature ?
note: Portuguese translation of the essay: serialized in 1947, collected in Situations II in 1948, issued separately in French in 1964. Choose the French standalone candidate, not the larger Situations collection.

original_title: Ἰλιάς
note: Homer’s Iliad; composition conventionally dated to the eighth or early seventh century BCE, not 2005. ISBN identifies the Cotovia/Frederico Lourenço translation, first published in 2005 and catalogued here in a 2008 printing; exact cited translation is unspecified.

original_title: Il nome e il come: scambio ineguale e mercato storiografico
container: Quaderni storici, vol. 14, no. 40 (1), January–April 1979, pp. 181–190; JSTOR stable 43777765
note: Coauthored by Carlo Ginzburg and Carlo Poni. O nome e o como is its Portuguese translation in A micro-história e outros ensaios (1989); candidate w-1188548 is the containing collection, not this article.

original_title: Os rumos da cidade: urbanismo e modernização em São Paulo
note: Book by Candido Malta Campos (Campos Neto), Senac São Paulo; no candidates. ISBN confirmed in the publisher’s price catalogue. The catalogue lists a 2001 product date, while the cited book is normally catalogued as 2002.

id: W:almeida|ricos e pobres em minas gerais
original_title: Ricos e pobres em Minas Gerais: produção e hierarquização social no mundo colonial, 1750–1822
note: Carla Maria Carvalho de Almeida’s 2010 Argvmentvm book, now listed by Fino Traço; distinct from its 2001 doctoral-thesis precursor. No candidates.

id: W:frieiro|o diabo na livraria do conego
original_title: O diabo na livraria do cônego
note: Standalone 1945 Cultura Brasileira work, 92 pp. Candidate w-1184413 is the 1981 enlarged collection with Como era Gonzaga? and other essays, not just this work. The abbreviated 1981 citation may designate that collection; no identifier for the standalone original was confirmed.

original_title: On Revolution
note: Da revolução is the earlier Portuguese title of On Revolution; choose the 1963 English original over Über die Revolution.

original_title: História do Brasil recente, 1964–1980
note: Later edition of the book by Sonia Regina de Mendonça and Virgínia Maria Fontes; the latter’s surname is omitted in the citation. Later editions expand the period covered to 1964–1992.

id: W:vainfas|casamento amor e desejo no ocidente cristao
original_title: Casamento, amor e desejo no Ocidente cristão
note: Ronaldo Vainfas, Ática, Série Princípios 69; not História e sexualidade no Brasil or Trópico dos pecados. ISBN appears in the library catalogue’s cover-image metadata for its 1986 record.

id: W:azevedo|o marques de pombal e a sua epoca
original_title: O Marquez de Pombal e a sua epoca
note: The 2004 Alameda reissue is by João Lúcio de Azevedo; the citation’s João Maria Cerqueira de Azevedo is an erroneous author expansion. Title and edition establish the match.

original_title: Édition et sédition: l’univers de la littérature clandestine au XVIIIe siècle
note: Publisher explicitly gives Edition et sedition as the original title of the 1992 Portuguese translation; not The Literary Underground of the Old Regime or The Forbidden Best-Sellers.

original_title: Sur la télévision, suivi de L’emprise du journalisme
note: Portuguese translation of the 1996 French book. The Brazilian edition adds a postscript and the Olympic Games text; these are supplements to the translated book. Choose the French candidate over On Television.

id: W:figueiredo|revoltas fiscalidade e identidade colonial na america portuguesa
original_title: Revoltas, fiscalidade e identidade colonial na América Portuguesa: Rio de Janeiro, Bahia e Minas Gerais, 1640–1761
container: Doctoral thesis, História Social, Faculdade de Filosofia, Letras e Ciências Humanas, Universidade de São Paulo, 1996; CAPH accession 3353N
note: Actually a doctoral thesis, not a published book: encoded as book only because the required kind vocabulary has no thesis value. USP confirms author, year, 564 pp., three volumes and accession 3353N. No LCCN, ISBN, OCLC or DOI confirmed.

original_title: La disputa del Nuovo Mondo: storia di una polemica, 1750–1900
note: O Novo Mundo: história de uma polêmica, 1750–1900 is the Portuguese edition of La disputa del Nuovo Mondo. Distinct from La natura delle Indie nove; choose the Italian original over The Dispute of the New World.

original_title: História do Maranhão
note: Mário Martins Meireles; first published by D.A.S.P., Serviço de Documentação, 1960, 395 pp. Distinct from his Pequena história do Maranhão (1959). No candidates.

original_title: Os desafios da escrita
note: Brazilian collection of five essays translated by Fulvia M. L. Moretto, arising from Chartier’s 2001 lectures in Brazil; no single prior French volume established. None of the candidates has these contents.

original_title: A história à prova do tempo: da história em migalhas ao resgate do sentido
note: Collection assembled for Brazil, translated by Ivone C. Benedetti; Dosse confirms in a 2024 Maracanan interview that it has no French counterpart. Not L’histoire (2000), L’histoire en miettes or L’empire du sens.

original_title: Immaginazione sociale
container: Enciclopedia Einaudi, vol. 7, 1979, pp. 53–92; Portuguese: Imaginação social, Enciclopédia Einaudi, vol. 5, Anthropos–Homem, Lisboa: INCM, 1985, pp. 296–332
note: Container title substituted for a contribution title. Most likely Baczko’s Imaginação social, but Utopia also appears in the same 1985 volume. Neither the whole encyclopedia nor the chapter is identical to Les imaginaires sociaux; entry identification remains provisional.

original_title: Roll, Jordan, Roll: The World the Slaves Made
note: UFMS catalogue explicitly identifies A terra prometida: o mundo que os escravos criaram (Paz e Terra, 1988) as the Portuguese translation of Roll, Jordan, Roll.
